summary: Design governed AI copilots and automation for finance, HR, procurement, and legal. Build your roadmap and register today.
lede: AI copilots and intelligent automation help shared-services professionals assess where administrative workflows can be improved responsibly. Participants map BPMN processes, establish productivity baselines, and prioritize finance, HR, procurement, and legal use cases. They also design human-review controls and risk matrices, measure benefits with service metrics, and create a staged implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals responsible for improving, governing, funding, or reporting AI-enabled administrative work across shared services. It is designed for role holders who need to connect process evidence with automation choices, controls, and executive decisions. Back-office AI augmentation is especially relevant when you must coordinate several support functions rather than optimize one isolated technology platform.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to at least one finance, HR, procurement, legal, shared-services, or enterprise systems process. No coding or programming is required. You should bring one representative process or service challenge, subject to your organization’s confidentiality rules. Advanced AI governance and automation architecture receive operational application and conceptual orientation, not production engineering treatment.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
